dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'C' and 'O' shaped structures on the mid-lateral flank characterized by a high-contrast transition from dark-charcoal perimeters to lighter-gray interiors. The perimeters are jagged and irregular, with the most prominent 'O' structure located superior to the visible flipper.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized, solid light-gray pixel clusters situated primarily between the larger annular structures. These clusters are small, lack internal gradients, and exhibit high contrast against the dark base pelt.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A scalene triangular geometry is formed by the centroids of the three largest 'O' structures on the upper-mid flank. The longest edge of this triangle is oriented along the anterior-posterior axis, roughly parallel to the dorsal midline.

other_distinctive_markers: A sharp, high-contrast boundary exists between the light-tan/brown mottled texture of the neck and flipper base and the deep charcoal/black base color of the dorsal-lateral flank.
